feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 August 2026 4:35am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 08 August 2026 at 4:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over Belgium, drifting eastwards, allowing weak weather fronts to affect the Irish Sea tonight and tomorrow.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 later this morning and afternoon, decreasing 3 or 4 again overnight. Locally Variable 2 or 3 at times in Liverpool and Morecambe Bays.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in central and western waters.


##Weather##

Fair, then outbreaks of rain slowly spreading from the west tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, veering West at times, then northwest later tomorrow and into early Monday.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain and drizzle, becoming fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in precipitation, perhaps poor in a few places at times.
